block.name: TID cascade avoidance -- four compounding gaps (punchlist #173)
acceptance_criteria: router.py: report_outcome records per-model success stats
router.py: _filter_candidates prunes models below 20pct rolling success (min 10 samples)
router.py: _score_cost accepts success_rate param, uses effective_cost = raw_cost/success_rate
model_client.py: is_rate_limited() and is_rate_limited_by_id() methods present
model_client.py: 429 handler populates _rate_limited with exponential backoff (60s base, 1800s cap)
app.py: rate-limited fallbacks skipped via is_rate_limited_by_id()
app.py: final report_outcome includes cascade_depth and cascade_total_ms in metadata
All three files have changelog entries for #173
python3 -m py_compile passes on all three files

never: Do not restart inference-difference systemd service
Do not modify vendored files: ng_lite.py, ng_peer_bridge.py, ng_ecosystem.py, ng_bridge.py, ng_autonomic.py
Do not reorder proxy pipeline hooks in app.py
anti_drift: Patch scripts use string.replace() with exact anchors -- do not rewrite whole functions
If idempotency check finds change already applied, skip that step (skipped != failed)

steps.description: Confirm patch scripts and target files exist

params.command: test -f /home/josh/The-Inference-Difference/scripts/patch_173_router.py && test -f /home/josh/The-Inference-Difference/scripts/patch_173_model_client.py && test -f /home/josh/The-Inference-Difference/scripts/patch_173_app.py && test -f /home/josh/The-Inference-Difference/inference_difference/router.py && echo READY

steps.description: Skip router patch if already applied
Apply router.py patch (success stats, floor filter, expected true cost)

params.command: cd /home/josh/The-Inference-Difference && venv/bin/python3 -m py_compile inference_difference/router.py && echo SYNTAX_OK

steps.description: Skip model_client patch if already applied

params.command: cd /home/josh/The-Inference-Difference && venv/bin/python3 -m py_compile inference_difference/model_client.py && echo SYNTAX_OK

steps.description: Skip app.py patch if already applied
Apply app.py patch (cascade tracking, rate-limit skip, cascade metadata)

params.command: cd /home/josh/The-Inference-Difference && venv/bin/python3 -m py_compile inference_difference/app.py && echo SYNTAX_OK

steps.description: Run TID test suite -- must pass 137+ tests

params.command: cd /home/josh/The-Inference-Difference && venv/bin/python3 -m pytest tests/test_inference_difference.py tests/test_catalog.py -x -q 2>&1 | tail -5

steps.description: Confirm all key symbols landed in each file

params.command: grep -l _model_success_stats /home/josh/The-Inference-Difference/inference_difference/router.py && grep -l is_rate_limited_by_id /home/josh/The-Inference-Difference/inference_difference/model_client.py && grep -l _cascade_start_ms /home/josh/The-Inference-Difference/inference_difference/app.py && echo ALL_PRESENT

steps.description: Commit the three changed files and push

params.command: cd /home/josh/The-Inference-Difference && git add inference_difference/router.py inference_difference/model_client.py inference_difference/app.py scripts/patch_173_router.py scripts/patch_173_model_client.py scripts/patch_173_app.py && git commit -m "Punchlist #173: cascade avoidance -- success floor, expected true cost, 429 backoff, cascade depth" && git push && echo PUSHED
